sections.content: Use *desde* + a starting point to say when an activity or situation began. The starting point can be a year, month, day or other time reference: desde el *año* *pasado*, desde *enero*, desde el *lunes*. When the action continues to the present, the present tense is common, and the pretérito perfecto can describe what has happened during that period: He estudiado *español* desde el año pasado.

items.spanish: Estudio español desde el año pasado.
items.english: I have been studying Spanish since last year.
I have lived in Vietnam since January.

items.spanish: He practicado español desde el lunes.
items.english: I have practised Spanish since Monday.

items.spanish: Nos conocemos desde el año pasado.
items.english: We have known each other since last year.

sections.content: Watch for the reverse mistake too: desde on its own wants a fixed starting point — desde *enero*, desde el *lunes* — not a length of time; swap in desde *hace* the moment you are naming a duration instead.
